business_summary: SIG Group Co., Ltd. provides system development, IT infrastructure construction, and security services in Japan. The company engages in the planning, drafting, development, and maintenance of information systems, such as insurance application website, takeout reservation for restaurants, surface mount manufacturing line system, and steel control system; and sales of various packaged software and hardware equipment, such as security products, automatic certificate issuing machine, automatic student discount card issuing machine, congestion information display system self-order system, and high performance EC site packages. It also engages in the design, construction, operation, and maintenance of cloud network security products, which includes public clouds, on-premises, and system maintenance; and sale of various security countermeasures solutions, such as security consulting network design and implementation support services, vulnerability assessment services, vulnerability assessment web application assessment, AWS environmental security assessment, endpoint security, email security, fingerprint authentication solutions, identity management software for enterprises, and penta security systems cloud-based WAF products. The company was formerly known as Sig Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SIG Group Co., Ltd. in October 2021. SIG Group Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
